common_workload: all4180 R3 database keyframes, prebuilt before R1 query phase; the same original100 query IDs and frozen173 attempted pairs for B0/B1/B2

B0.sensor_clouds: full original float32 XYZ, no crop/voxel before upload; intensity verified unused by frozen SC/GICP
B0.trigger: cloud arrival implicitly requests retrieval, no redundant request

B1.query: R1 full SC upload plus explicit CANDIDATE_REQUEST
B1.geometric: central requests query cloud once and candidate clouds in frozen attempt order; unbounded received-cloud cache
B1.descriptor_extraction_location: robot-local proxy, measured on server host

B2.query: R1 Ring Key + CANDIDATE_REQUEST; central requests query full SC and each actual M1000 shortlist full SC on cache miss
B2.cache: UNBOUNDED primary; NONE/LRU128/LRU1000 sensitivity, no selection/ranking change
B2.geometric: same frozen requests and cloud cache as B1

B3.scope: ORACLE LOWER BOUND; separate Stage20 dual stream, not a common frontend-workload competitor
B3.updates: 5796 initial/relative odometry messages plus75 archived loops; initial R3 pose is node metadata, NOT a second global prior
B3.producer: robot1 logical oracle producer for frozen inter-robot constraints; no claim of online discovery on robot1

shared.operation_locations: retrieval/GICP/iSAM2 are central; descriptor extraction logical location depends on mode; all new timing measurements physically on server
shared.missing: sensor acquisition/EKF creation cost, physical robot CPU, real transport, correction/map distribution policy NOT_MEASURED
shared.no_automatic_downlink: GLOBAL_POSE_CORRECTION/MAP_CHUNK schemas measured separately; no invented send cadence or ACKs
shared.byte_rules: actual entire encoded buffers, application framing included; raw NPY/ZIP sizes never network counts
shared.compressed: actual zlib1 length for each logical message; no packet/link overhead
shared.rate: query-phase bytes / actual span of100 original query timestamps; DB synchronization phase reported separately, not assigned fictitious instantaneous bandwidth
